content_sections.heading: CNCI Security Guard Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CNCI Security Guard Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: cnci.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CNCI Security Guard recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the CNCI Security Guard posts is 30 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Security Guard post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies announced for the Security Guard position at the Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Security Guard role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Security Guard post will receive a salary of Rs. 26208 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Security Guard position?
faq.answer: Eligibility includes being an Ex-serviceman, Ex-policeman, ex-paramilitary personnel, Agni veer, or a holder of an NCC-B Certificate.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Security Guard post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Security Guard position is 55 years. Age relaxation may be provided based on experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Security Guard recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening, followed by a decision from the Selection Committee and final approval from the Director.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the CNCI Security Guard job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Download the form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach documents, and send it via post before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this CNCI recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Security Guard post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute, cnci.ac.in.
